records.title: SynerDiff: Synergetic Continuous Batching for Fast and Parallel Diffusion Model Inference
records.reason: SynerDiff is a continuous-batching scheduler for diffusion-model serving, reporting 1.6x throughput and up to 78.7% lower latency through UNet/VAE scheduling. The system-level batching ideas may transfer to serving, and the candidate is linked to LLM scheduling, but its experiments and resource bottlenecks are specific to diffusion image generation rather than LLM inference.

records.title: Can MLLMs Reason About Visual Persuasion? Evaluating the Efficacy and Faithfulness of Reasoning
records.reason: 一次abstractはvisual-persuasion reasoningの評価を示し、直接の効率改善を示さないが、linked lineageとの本文上の関係は未確認。一次本文を取得できなかったためborderlineに保持する。

records.title: Beyond Thinking: Imagining in 360$^\circ$ for Humanoid Visual Search
records.reason: The paper decomposes humanoid visual search into Imaginator/Actor agent roles and evaluates search task behavior. Its focus is embodied task planning and trajectory reasoning, not LLM inference-system efficiency.

records.title: LBI: Parallel Scan Backpropagation via Latent Bounded Interfaces
records.reason: LBI accelerates parallel-scan backpropagation for sequential models by reducing training dependency depth and Jacobian composition cost. This is training/backpropagation efficiency, not inference.

records.title: TAS-LoRA: Transformer Architecture Search with Mixture-of-LoRA Experts
records.reason: TAS-LoRA searches ViT architectures using LoRA experts to improve subnet training and architecture selection. The primary text concerns vision-transformer training/search, not LLM inference or serving.
